title: inbox.changed payload
description: Emitted by Notifications & Messaging, in the transaction of the change, once per PERSON whose inbox it changed (EP-25.7): a task assigned to them or one they take part in moved, a message reached them, a notification was raised for them. A PERSONAL message — the WebSocket service delivers it only to connections authenticated as `recipientUserId`, in its channel, whatever anyone's grants (websocket §5). It names WHAT changed and nothing of its content: the client re-reads its inbox through the API, which enforces who may read what. A recipient addressed through a group or a role is not named here (yet): such rows reach their readers by polling.

recipientUserId.description: The one person this frame is for.

kind.description: Which list of the inbox changed.

id.description: The task, message or notification that changed.
